subject: type IV interaction: ends with inla crash error

messages.author: 92737d96d07e78d4
messages.subject: type IV interaction: ends with inla crash error
parts:
Dear all,

I am running a spatiotemporal model with type 4 interaction along with 8 covariates. The model was running for nearly 4 days and ended with the following error. I have used the INLA_version 22.04.06. 

maxld= -85408.517 fn=914 theta= 2.021 -0.833 3.924 3.118 2.508 [6.3, 680.51]
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
In addition: There were 50 or more warnings (use warnings() to see the first 50).


For your kind reference, I have attached the r-script for the same.
